note: setTheme(null) forgets the user's theme choice: it removes the saved theme in every tab and applies the theme the page starts with when nothing was chosen (dark for a system that prefers it under ThemeScript or initTheme with auto, else the default theme), following prefers-color-scheme again afterwards. getTheme() and useTheme() keep returning the theme in effect. Without ThemeScript or initTheme on the page, the system preference is taken once.
